items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Backs Anthem Catalog Deal And Eyes BNY Blockchain Platform
items.summary: Influence Media Partners, backed by BlackRock, has agreed to acquire Anthem Entertainment's music publishing catalogs and related assets, including high profile music and film content. items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Q2 Beat And Analyst Upgrades
items.summary: BlackRock has seen its modeled fair value move to US$1,313.50 from US$1,273.69, a shift that helps frame how some analysts are resetting expectations after the Q2 earnings beat. Recent research has turned more constructive, with several firms lifting price targets into a US$1,250 to US$1,488 range as they reassess BlackRock’s earnings power, organic growth, and the mix between ETFs and higher fee products. Read on to see how this evolving narrative might matter for your own view on the stock...
